logline: A young Ethiopian couple, told their chance of a child is under one percent, refuse to stop; only at the birth do we learn who is telling the story.
audience: Draft, to be confirmed by the applicant: families and couples in Ethiopia and the diaspora who are waiting for something they have been told is unlikely
intent: Feel that a small chance is still a chance, and want to keep trying
style_block: 3D animated film frame with a painted look, sculpted rounded characters with expressive faces, hand-painted textures and visible soft brush strokes on 3D forms, painterly background, warm amber and terracotta palette with deep indigo shadows, gentle cinematic light, subject centred in frame, full-bleed picture reaching every edge

people.statement: Based on the applicant's own family story. Faces are invented drawings made from text and the narrator is a stock synthetic voice. Nobody's photograph or recording is used. Consent is recorded in ETHICS.md.

am.style: a young man, warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

mother.style: a mother, warm and heartfelt, speaking gently to her family

mother.prompt: Character portrait of an invented young Ethiopian woman in her twenties, oval face, warm brown skin, dark hair parted in the centre and drawn back under a thin white cotton netela shawl with a narrow green and gold woven border, long white handwoven cotton dress, small plain round silver stud earrings, hopeful calm expression, facing the viewer, plain warm background, upper body

father.prompt: Character portrait of an invented young Ethiopian man in his late twenties, slim face, warm brown skin, short dark hair, trimmed short beard, white handwoven cotton collared shirt, kind steady expression, facing the viewer, plain warm background, upper body

cues.note: A few gentle plucked notes under the couple
The opening notes return, then fade on the end card

shots.reason: Meets a husband and wife as strangers, so the later reveal is a surprise
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference and the same man from the second reference as young newlyweds standing side by side in white handwoven cotton clothes with green and gold borders, shoulders touching, smiling at each other, warm afternoon garden behind
shots.motion_prompt: The couple turn toward each other and smile, she laughs softly, their clothes move in a light wind, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ሁለት በወጣትነታቸው የተጋቡ ባልና ሚስት ነበሩ፤ ልጅ እንደሚወልዱም እርግጠኛ ነበሩ።
narration.en: There were a husband and a wife who married young. They were sure they would have children.

shots.reason: Time passes on the couple themselves: the same two people, the same step, no one else
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference and the same man from the second reference sitting close together on the stone doorstep of a small house, looking out over an empty quiet yard, dry leaves falling from a tree, late afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: Leaves fall slowly past them, she leans her head onto his shoulder, his chest rises with a breath, the camera pushes in very slowly

narration.am: ሆኖም አንድ ዓመት አለፈ። ከዚያም ሁለት። ከዚያም አምስት።
narration.en: But one year passed. Then two. Then five.

shots.reason: Their waiting is active: prayer and patience
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the reference seated by candlelight at night, white shawl over her hair, eyes closed, hands pressed together near her chest, quiet prayer, dark room
shots.motion_prompt: Her lips move silently in prayer, she breathes slowly, the candle flame flickers, the camera is fixed

shots.reason: The bad news, held on the couple rather than the doctor
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference and the same man from the second reference seated close together in a plain consulting room, holding hands tightly, heads lowered, cool daylight from a high window
shots.motion_prompt: Her shoulders rise and fall with a heavy breath, he slowly squeezes her hand and turns his head to her, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ከዚያም ሐኪሙ፦ በኢትዮጵያ የመውለድ ዕድላቸው ከአንድ በመቶ በታች መሆኑን ነገራቸው።
narration.en: Then the doctor told them that in Ethiopia, their chance of having a child was less than one percent.

shots.reason: The turn: the couple choose a question over an ending
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference lifting her face with a determined look toward the same man from the second reference beside her, warm lamp light on both faces, night window behind
shots.motion_prompt: She raises her head and speaks, her lips moving, he looks at her and nods slowly, the camera pushes in gently

narration.am: ብዙ ሰው እዚህ ጋር ተስፋ ይቆርጥ ነበር። እነሱ ግን ጠየቁ፦ «ሌላ የት እንሞክር?»
narration.en: Many people would have lost hope here. But they asked: “Where else can we try?”

shots.reason: Distance made visible: far from home, the same two people
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference and the same man from the second reference seen from behind, walking hand in hand along a sunlit pale stone hillside street with olive trees, one small suitcase, morning light ahead of them
shots.motion_prompt: They walk slowly forward, her shawl and the olive leaves move in the wind, the camera follows gently behind

narration.am: መልሱ ሩቅ ነበር፤ እስራኤል። አዲስ ሃገር፣ አዲስ ሐኪሞች፣ አዲስ ቋንቋ፣ አራት አመት።
narration.en: The answer was far away: Israel. A new country, new doctors, a new language. Four years.

shots.reason: The birth, in a hand rather than a face; it does not say yet whose life this is
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close view of a newborn baby hand with tiny fingers wrapped around one adult finger, white blanket, soft golden morning light
shots.motion_prompt: The tiny fingers slowly open and close around the finger, the blanket moves with breathing, the camera is fixed

narration.en: And then… a baby was born.

shots.reason: The reveal: the narrator was the baby all along
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference holding a newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket against her chest, the same man from the second reference leaning in beside her, both looking down at the baby with tears of joy, soft golden window light
shots.motion_prompt: She rocks the baby gently and smiles, he bows his head toward them, the baby stirs, the camera pushes in slowly

shots.reason: The emotional peak: the line she still says, on her face
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the reference, older now with a few silver hairs, face filling the frame, joyful eyes, mouth open speaking warmly toward the viewer, golden window light
shots.motion_prompt: She speaks warmly, her lips and jaw moving naturally, then breaks into a smile and blinks, the camera is fixed

narration.am: እናቴ ዛሬም ትላለች፦ «ሌሎች ሴቶች በዘጠኝ ወር ይወልዳሉ፤ እኔ ግን በዘጠኝ ዓመት ወለድኩ።»
narration.en: My mother still says: “Other women give birth in nine months. But I gave birth in nine years.”

shots.reason: The family keeps growing: one child becomes three
shots.image_prompt: An older boy, a younger girl and a small boy seen from behind running together across a sunny green field, holding hands, white cotton clothes, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: The three children run forward hand in hand, clothes and grass move in the wind, the camera follows gently

narration.am: ከዚያ ታናሽ እህቴ፣ ከዚያም ታናሽ ወንድሜ መጡ።
narration.en: Then came my little sister. Then my little brother.

shots.reason: The same doorstep that was empty is now full
shots.image_prompt: the same woman from the first reference and the same man from the second reference, older, sitting on the stone doorstep of a small house with two boys and one girl seen from behind around them, all close together, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: The family lean together and laugh, shoulders moving, a child hugs the mother, the camera pulls back slowly

narration.am: ያ አንድ በመቶ እኔ ነበርኩ። ሁላችንም ነን።
narration.en: I was that one percent. We all are.

shots.reason: Turns to the viewer with the light still ahead
shots.image_prompt: A family of five seen from far behind as small figures walking together up a green hill toward a huge golden sunrise, long soft shadows, open sky
shots.motion_prompt: The family walk slowly up the hill, grass sways, the sunlight grows brighter, the camera rises slowly

narration.am: ዕድላችሁ አንድ በመቶ ነው ቢሏችሁ፣ አስታውሱ፦ አንድ በመቶ ዜሮ አይደለም። ተስፋ አትቁረጡ።
narration.en: If they tell you your chance is one percent, remember: one percent is not zero. Never give up.

lines: Pictures, voice and music made with AI
A true family story. All faces are invented.
